name: Document Editor
description: Persian and English image-to-text OCR, automatic document scanning, PDF and editable Word export, and QR/barcode reading in one optional capability.

license.name: Apache-2.0, BSD-2-Clause, libpng and IJG
license.attribution: Tesseract OCR 5.5.1, Tesseract4Android 4.9.0, tessdata_fast Persian/English models, Google ML Kit Document Scanner and Google Code Scanner. Leptonica retains its BSD-2-Clause notice.

release_notes: Make ML Kit initialization idempotent so reopening Barcode/QR Reader or Document Scanner does not fail when the isolated runtime is already initialized.
